cases.question: ¿Qué asientos registrados no cuadraron entre debe y haber en agosto de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT je.id, je.code, je.entry_date, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-09-01' GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date HAVING ABS(SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit)) > 0.01 ORDER BY je.entry_date DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT je.code AS code, je.entry_date AS entry_date, je.description AS description FROM public.journal_entry AS je JOIN public.journal_entry_detail AS jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date, je.description HAVING ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0), 2) <> ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0), 2) LIMIT 50
